title: Dutch Hash with Hearty Vegetables
description: A hearty and flavorful hash made with diced vegetables and meat, perfect for a comforting meal. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss diced potatoes, carrots, and onions with olive oil, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the potato mixture onto a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add crumbled bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy.
Add the roasted vegetables to the skillet and stir to combine with the meat and bacon.
Transfer the hash to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
